summary: add-component refined from the Input run and the full-library review. Adds a second governing rule beside the ratchet: THE FIRST-OF-ITS-KIND RULE — the first component to do something new breaks the tooling for it, so budget for fixing gates before code. Probing a new or changed gate is promoted from advice to a required numbered step, because three gates in this repo have reported success while measuring nothing. New guidance: interrogate focus and error states during spec (both of Input's serious design defects lived there); pin roles in ZERO_AUTHORED.dark as well as light and add them to CONTRAST_PAIRS, since an unlisted pair is an unchecked pair; register a new utility family in BOTH cn.ts and check-utilities.mjs; the compound-component forwarding contract (className outermost, ref to the interactive element for form controls); await running transitions before reading computed style; stories are gates rather than demos now that each runs through axe. Traps table reordered by likelihood and grown from 12 to 18 rows. Definition of done now requires both-scheme contrast measurement and a failing-first probe of any gate touched.

migration.manual: Invoke the skill at the start of component work as before; the pipeline steps are unchanged in order, stricter in content.
